follow-up time: from admission for cesarean delivery until discharge
cohort: 401 women who underwent cesarean delivery in Nekemte Town Public Hospitals, Ethiopia
finding: The prevalence of SSIs was 8.9%, and factors associated with SSI included age > 35 years, pregnancy-induced hypertension, prolonged labor, receiving general anesthesia, and post-operative hemoglobin less than 11 g/dl.
